name: collapsible
useFor: Use Collapsible for one optional section (advanced settings, the full list of checks). Use the built-in trigger for a quiet text toggle, or asChild with a Button (ghost icon-sm) beside a heading. For several sections in a column, use Accordion.
constraints: A caret that moves on hover
Content that fades or slides in sideways
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website: the changelog's quiet disclosures (.cl-entry__summary) and the FAQ's height animation (.faq__item)
title: Collapsible
description: A section that opens in place: a 14px medium graphite trigger with a caret that turns a quarter when open, and a panel that opens with its height.
